what.text: This page follows refugees from the Niger living in Mali, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 68961 Nigerien refugees in Mali, 80.6% of all refugees from the Niger.
Mali is by far the largest host, followed by Nigeria, Benin and Chad.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in the Niger from 2015 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict over the government of the Niger with JNIM from 2021 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2018 at 1024 refugees.
The main year of displacement in the data is 2025, when the figure is at its highest.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Mali.
These are year-end totals for Mali only, reported to UNHCR.
